requirements.text: Preserve authentic product appearance, construction, and existing physical product branding without alteration or plastic retouching.
Deliver a shoot asset system covering Icon, Inhabited Hero, World, and Intelligence assets for product launches.

preferences.text: Frame products within contemporary, warm architectural spaces featuring limewash, natural wood, and directional daylight.
Depict believable, unforced human body language such as stretching, turning, reading, or reclining rather than presenter poses.

visualRules.value: Red is reserved as a brand identification signal (logo, CTA, detail line, accent); do not use red for entire room walls, bedding, props, or outfits.
Deliver four distinct shot classes for product assets: Icon, Inhabited Hero, World, and Intelligence.
Maintain truthful product texture, fabric weave, seams, and physical tags without applying artificial blur masks or contrast fades.

preserve: Official solid red symbol and uppercase DUROFLEX brand identity as published on current official channels.
Truthful product representation including fabric texture, physical construction, and authentic product labels.
Strategic positioning centered on Motivating Reset and Designed to De-Stress.
explore: Warm Indian Modernism architecture with pale textured walls, natural wood, and integrated greenery.
Human interaction showing authentic moments of pause, reading, conversation, and natural bodily release.
Category-specific lighting environments such as morning daylight for sleep products and warm evening light for sofas.
avoid: Environmental red flooding including red curtains, red bedding, red props, or red outfits.
Medical, anatomical, or clinical efficacy promises without product-specific approved evidence.
Artificial photo manipulation including contrast fades, blur masks, haze, or fake white overlays inside photography.
Presenter poses, forced advertising smiles, and cluttered showroom staging.
unknowns: Final production master status for lowercase serif draft logo vs official solid red uppercase mark.
Exact vector master typography and hex palette codes (the Visual World Guide remains a draft document).
Formal adoption status of proposed portfolio architecture (Restore, Recharge, Oasis, Recalibrate) vs active website navigation.
guide.decisionSummary: This execution guide anchors Duroflex creative work in supplied strategy and verified brand evidence. Accurate product presentation and authentic physical branding must be maintained across all executions. Red is disciplined strictly as a brand punctuation mark rather than an environmental background. Creative execution leverages Warm Indian Modernism, natural daylight, and believable human rest while strictly avoiding clinical promises, artificial image filters, or unverified portfolio naming.
